summary: Cadeler plc filed a routine Form 6-K attaching a press release dated 5 November 2026 announcing the opening of a new office in Rotterdam, its fifth global location alongside Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich and Taipei. No securities, ownership, capital-structure or corporate-control event is disclosed. The release describes staffing of operations, engineering and technical teams to support Netherlands and European offshore wind projects, citing the city's maritime cluster. Quotes come from Karel Wagner, VP Head of Asset Development and General Manager NL. No board recommendation, advisor, price or stake appears; watch for ordinary operational updates only.
